title: Geologic Map of the Blue Springs Landing Quadrangle, Allendale and Hampton Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2012, Geologic Map of the Blue Springs Landing Quadrangle, Allendale and Hampton Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-199, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single map sheet read from OCR (page 1). Map symbols are garbled ('[ aHps |', '54,', 'ap ... phr') and were not recorded. The Water unit was not recorded. Legend-only features (contact) were not recorded as values. Three thicknesses printed with '|' for a digit are read as 1, flagged inferred and sent to review. Georgia portions of the quadrangle are not mapped. Units are grouped by the terrace they lie beneath (Holocene, Ladson, Penholoway).
SUBSURFACE: Holocene terrace sediments generally below 10 ft at the landward margin against the Silver Bluff terrace (page 1). No drill holes, cross sections or structure contours appear in the OCR text. Datum: horizontal 1927 North American Datum; contour interval 10 feet on the 1978 base map; the vertical datum is not stated (page 1).
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet; map face is noise). Units grouped by the terrace they lie beneath (Holocene, Ladson, Penholoway) as before; map symbols, garbled in the OCR, read from the legend boxes on a page-image tile. Holocene terrace sediments generally below 10 ft at the landward margin: recorded as the unit's contact and as a stated top at that margin (boundary inferred; no vertical datum printed). Three thicknesses printed with '|' for a digit read as 1 (inferred). Whole-page image checked: no cross section, drill holes or structure contours on the sheet. Water unit, the Georgia not-mapped area and the legend-only contact are not recorded.
